title: People
subtitle: Each person has their own accounts, transactions, bills, debts and goals — Pluggy credentials live here per person, not in .env.
empty: No one set up yet — use "Add person" to add the first one.

addForm.title: Add a person
addForm.subtitle: Name is required; Pluggy fields can be filled in later.

form.name: Name
form.pluggyItemIdsPlaceholder: Comma-separated Item IDs for this person's connected bank(s)

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Sent when a sync rule fires (a large transaction, a projected shortfall) — pick where this person hears about it.
notifications.destinationsSubtitle: Where this person hears about it.

rules.title: Notification rules
rules.subtitle: Household defaults — anyone without their own override gets these.
rules.perPersonSubtitle: Only affects this person — everyone else keeps using the household default above.

largeTransaction.label: Large transaction
largeTransaction.description: Fires when a newly synced transaction is at or above the threshold.
largeTransaction.thresholdHint: A transaction at or above this amount triggers this notification.

projectedShortfall.label: Projected shortfall
projectedShortfall.description: Fires when next month's cash-flow projection goes negative.

providerSetup.title: Provider setup
providerSetup.subtitle: One-time, app-wide credentials each provider needs to actually deliver anything — set once here, then each person above just adds their own destination.

categories.title: Categories
categories.subtitle: Shared across the whole household — renaming or recoloring here updates it everywhere.
categories.protected: Uncategorized can't be deleted — it's the default fallback

categoryRules.title: Category rules
categoryRules.description: Auto-applied to every new transaction at sync time, matched in insertion order against the normalized description. Created whenever you (or the assistant, via MCP) categorize a group or reclassify a pattern — or add one yourself below. Adding a rule here only affects future transactions; it doesn't retroactively reclassify existing ones.
categoryRules.searchPlaceholder: Search rules by match text or category…

appSettings.subtitle: Preferences for the whole household — language, sync schedule, and alert thresholds.

sync.title: Sync
sync.subtitle: Cron schedule for the daily sync, and thresholds used by notification rules and cash-flow projections.
sync.cronScheduleHint: Standard 5-field cron expression (minute hour day month weekday) — the default runs daily at 6am.
sync.minBufferHint: A projected month with a balance below this amount is flagged as a shortfall, on the Projections page and in the projected-shortfall notification.

pushover.title: Pushover
pushover.subtitle: One app-level token for the whole deployment, from pushover.net/apps/build.

smtp.title: Email (SMTP)
smtp.subtitle: One relay for the whole deployment.

profile.subtitle: Edit this person's details, Pluggy connection, and card spend goal.
